build_data2vec_audio_model: build a Data2VecAudioModel for self-supervised audio representation learning from raw waveforms
run_data2vec_audio_ctc: run Data2VecAudioForCTC for connectionist temporal classification of speech sequences
train_data2vec_audio_classification: train Data2VecAudioForSequenceClassification for audio task classification like keyword spotting
extract_xvector_embeddings: extract speaker verification embeddings using Data2VecAudioForXVector with TDNN and statistic pooling
classify_audio_frames: classify audio frames per token using Data2VecAudioForAudioFrameClassification with token-level predictions
